realHistoricalInput.transport: Explicit same-origin historical envelope interception in a local fixture server
realHistoricalInput.chartCoordinates: OHLC derived from the same partial native IEX executions. Marker quantities come directly from execution reports.

limits: Local browser proof does not establish production publication, authentication, deployment, or a live feed.
Outer application chrome and other source cases use deterministic fixtures. Native IEX export coordinates derive from the reviewed partial transaction cohort.
Seven desktop-specific journeys intentionally skip tablet and mobile; the real IEX export runs on all three.
Phone gestures use trusted browser-native emulated touch events with no supplied timestamps; this is not physical-device or human-cadence evidence.
The exact browser boundary was198x89 CSS px at a261x900 viewport; the198x88 admission threshold also has unit coverage. Classic scrollbar allowance is a reviewed source budget.
The1,000,000,000 quantity is synthetic. No distinct-order, trapped-trader, live-CME or predictive-efficacy claim is made.
Older original-candidate evidence remains historical and is not restamped.
